project_type: Next.js 16 monorepo (apps/web) with server-side FFmpeg render pipeline
test_framework: vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library, tests in src/lib/**/*.test.ts
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/anything-clipper && yarn workspaces focus web && yarn workspace web typecheck
verification_instructions: 1. Run yarn workspace web typecheck to ensure no TS errors. 2. Run yarn workspace web test to run vitest. 3. Confirm new modules have test coverage.
setup_instructions: corepack enable && yarn workspaces focus web
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. FFmpeg available on host for smoke tests. No DATABASE_URL available in sandbox (DB-dependent routes cannot be integration tested). No ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY, no ANYTHING_PROJECT_TOKEN in sandbox.
contribution_requirements: CI runs typecheck + vitest. Tests should not require external services (mock or unit test only). Follow existing patterns: rate limit + auth on API routes, chatCompletionJson for AI calls, presigned storage for media.
key_patterns: API routes at src/app/api/*/route.ts. Lib modules at src/lib/*. AI calls via chatCompletionJson (apps/web/src/app/api/utils/ai.ts). Render specs are JSONB stored on render_jobs. FFmpeg args built by buildFfmpegArgs. Object storage via presignUpload/presignDownload. Rate limiting via consumeRateLimit. Quota checks via checkPlanQuota.
directory_structure: apps/web/src/app/api/ - API routes. apps/web/src/lib/ - shared logic (render, captions, clip, billing, publish). apps/web/src/app/ - pages. apps/web/migrations/ - SQL migrations. apps/web/scripts/ - worker scripts.
